title: +EMPOWERING CLIMATE ACTION FOR A SUSTAINABLE FUTURE
description: Explores the psychological impacts of climate change and evaluates global and local mitigation strategies. Examines the relationship between climate change and mental wellbeing, psychological distress, neurological functioning, and overall health. Emphasizes identifying and addressing psychological barriers and develops solutions for effective climate action to benefit diverse stakeholders through transdisciplinary collaboration.
